method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates a low-alpha tiled grid image with the literal grid material and 22-by-22 nine-slice setup, four corner-dot images, then an alpha-zero additive pip. This is decoration only; no marker selection, positioning or networking is implemented here. Exact child order: TiledShaderImage, CornerDot1, CornerDot2, CornerDot3, CornerDot4, Pip2. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.
